sloka: भक्षितो राघवो ऽस्माभिर्लक्ष्मणश्चेति वादिनः।तव पादौ ग्रहीष्यामस्त्वं नः कामं प्रपूरय ।। ६.६४.२६ ।।
transliteration: bhakṣito rāghavo 'smābhirlakṣmaṇaśceti vādinaḥ।tava pādau grahīṣyāmastvaṁ naḥ kāmaṁ prapūraya ।। 6.64.26 ।।

translations.english: "We too will hold your feet saying 'Rama and Lakshmana have been devoured by us'. Then you will grant our desires."
